name: jesutobits
description: The Jesutobits agent: plans, edits, runs and verifies your project, with every action shown and permissioned.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode the agent can read and answer but never edits files or runs commands.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Jesutobits
walkthroughs.description: Connect a model provider and give the agent its first task.

steps.title: Add your OpenRouter API key
steps.description:
Jesutobits calls models through OpenRouter. The key is typed into a password box and kept in your system's credential store; Jesutobits never shows it again.
[Set API key](command:jesutobits.setApiKey)

steps.title: Choose a default model
steps.description:
Pick the model new sessions use. Models that cannot use tools only work in Ask mode.
[Choose model](command:jesutobits.chooseModel)

steps.title: Give the agent a task
steps.description:
Open a folder, then ask the agent to change something. You approve anything risky, every step shows in the timeline, and Revert turn undoes a turn's edits.
[Open the agent](command:jesutobits.openAgent)

jesutobits.providers.openrouter.enabled.description: Use OpenRouter for the agent's model calls.

jesutobits.providers.openrouter.profile.description: Which stored OpenRouter key to use. The key itself lives in the OS credential store, never in settings.

jesutobits.providers.openrouter.defaultM.description: Model for new agent sessions, for example `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5`.

jesutobits.providers.openrouter.dataColl.description: Whether OpenRouter may route to providers that keep or train on prompts.

jesutobits.providers.openrouter.allowFal.description: Let OpenRouter use another provider for the same model when the first is unavailable.

jesutobits.agent.defaultPolicyPreset.description: How often the agent asks before acting, for projects without a preset of their own.

jesutobits.agent.limits.stepsPerTurn.description: Model steps per turn before the agent stops and asks.

jesutobits.agent.limits.toolCallsPerTurn.description: Tool calls per turn before the agent stops and asks.

jesutobits.agent.limits.turnMinutes.description: Minutes per turn before the agent stops and asks.

jesutobits.agent.limits.costPerTurnUsd.description: Model cost per turn, in US dollars, before the agent stops and asks.

jesutobits.agent.limits.costPerSessionUs.description: Model cost per session, in US dollars, before the agent stops and asks.

jesutobits.agent.limits.fixAttempts.description: Attempts to fix a failing check before the agent reports it.

jesutobits.privacy.logModelTraffic.description: Log model requests and responses (secrets are always masked).

jesutobits.privacy.providerAttributionHe.description: Send Jesutobits' name to OpenRouter in attribution headers.
